|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Withering Step''' is a [[movement]] [[skill]] that applies the {{stl|Elusive}} and {{stl|Phasing}} [[buff]]s on use. Enemies that get near you while you have Elusive receive multiple stacks of the {{stl|Withered}} [[debuff]] for a duration, causing them to take increased [[chaos damage]]. Using any skill ends Withering Step's effects and removes all buffs, except the {{stl|Withered}} debuff on enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Withering Step shares a [[cooldown]] with other [[:Category:Blink (gem tag)|Blink]] skills. * Unlike several other Blink skills, Withering Step does not gain one additional use when supported by {{il|Second Wind Support}}, since Withering Step is an [[instant]] skill. * Withering Step can be supported by {{il|Spell Totem Support}}, the skill shares a global cooldown between the player and all [[totem]]s. * Using another skill during Withering Step's effect removes the {{stl|Phasing}} and {{stl|Elusive}} buffs granted by the skill. It does not end the effect of {{stl|Withered}} applied to enemies during the skill's effect. * The duration of the {{stl|Withered}} debuff applied by Withering Step can be modified by increases and reductions to Skill Effect Duration, such as {{il|Increased Duration Support}} and being affected by {{il|Malevolence}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Withered
